False friends — these match the words but not the capability, so do
not list them:
- Downgrade or exclude OCR papers that measure character/word recognition, denoising, deskewing or transcription accuracy only and do not recover document structure or grounded evidence.
- Downgrade document layout papers that only detect region boxes when they do not address logical structure, reading order, region relations or downstream semantic preservation; retain them only as supporting extraction evidence.
- Do not treat document classification as document understanding for this topic unless the method also preserves or exposes source-level structured evidence.
- Downgrade key-information-extraction papers whose entire task is filling a fixed schema from simple single-page forms if they provide no evidence about arbitrary tables, images, multi-page structure or grounding.
- Downgrade generic image captioning: producing a plausible description without identifying the supporting source region does not satisfy visual grounding.
- Downgrade generic VQA and natural-image visual grounding unless the paper contributes a mechanism plausibly transferable to document regions; label such papers TRANSFER.
- Downgrade RefCOCO-style referring-expression papers to TRANSFER unless they evaluate document, screenshot, chart or other structured visual surfaces.
- Downgrade multimodal coreference based only on natural-image narrations, videos or embodied dialogue to TRANSFER.
- For table work, table detection alone is supporting evidence, not table understanding; require structure reconstruction, functional roles, semantic relations or QA for core admission.
- For table QA, distinguish clean-table reasoning from document-table understanding. Papers receiving normalized relational tables are TRANSFER for extraction/structure preservation even if directly relevant to downstream reasoning.
- Downgrade methods that reconstruct cell values but ignore headers, merged cells, hierarchy, units or row-column association when the claimed contribution is table semantics.
- For spreadsheet work, exclude or downgrade autonomous editing, formula generation and agent benchmarks unless they evaluate semantic understanding of the existing workbook structure.
- Downgrade synthetic chart benchmarks when their visual extraction problem is trivial or underlying data tables are supplied; retain only as TRANSFER for reasoning mechanisms.
- Exclude attachment-security literature such as malicious attachment detection, phishing, malware scanning and forensic MIME extraction unless it also studies semantic content understanding.
- Exclude email classification, spam detection and phishing detection merely because attachments are present.
- Downgrade UI/screenshot papers focused only on click/action prediction or navigation; admit screenshot work when it reconstructs or grounds textual/visual structure.
- Exclude citation-context identification, citation recommendation and bibliometric citation localization; these use 'citation localization' in a different sense from source-evidence grounding.
- Downgrade document retrieval and page retrieval to TRANSFER/supporting evidence. Topic 08 begins after the relevant object has been obtained; retrieval by itself belongs to Topic 07.
- Exclude document similarity, plagiarism detection and duplicate detection from version-comparison evidence unless the method localizes and characterizes changes between known revisions.
- Downgrade pixel-level visual document differencing, rendering regression and image registration when they do not distinguish semantic change from formatting or rasterization noise.
- Do not accept a paper as evidence for attachment-version identity merely because it compares two files. Version identity, lineage and supersession must be represented explicitly or remain an open engineering/product gap.
- Do not treat page-level answer retrieval as precise grounding when the product requirement is a cell, region or evidence span. Record the granularity actually supported.
- Do not treat an answer string that happens to occur in the document as proof of grounding. Prefer tasks or evaluations with explicit page, token, cell, region or bounding-box supervision.
- Do not infer workplace-email accuracy from scientific documents, receipts, forms, natural images or synthetic charts. Label such evidence DIRECT only for the academic subproblem it actually studies and TRANSFER for the workplace-domain claim.
- A parser failure, unsupported embedded object or omitted page is not a successful empty extraction; papers or systems that silently discard unsupported content do not satisfy msgloom's preservation requirement.
Reach back to 1984 at least. Discovery must reach at least 1984 because document-image segmentation and hierarchical page-structure work was already established in the early 1980s, including 1984 work on hierarchical representations of optically scanned documents and a 1984 survey of document segmentation. Core table-structure-recognition work appears by the early 1990s. Restricting discovery to the recent transformer era would therefore erase the foundations of layout segmentation, logical structure, reading order and table recognition. Bulk discovery should cover 1984-present; backward citations earlier than 1984 should still be followed when a directly relevant foundational source is identified.
